text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Now then, shall we begin soon? Alright, 
everyone, all together on three—

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Machitan, congrats on the fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: "No, no, thank you very much. Hehehe..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To celebrate Machikane Tannhauser 
receiving a fan letter, her friends had 
gathered today to throw a party.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Tannhauser-san. Please share 
your thoughts right now.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Man, I was so thrilled after getting that 
letter. Not only did I carry it 
everywhere, but I even kept it right by my 
pillow at night~

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"You know, to me, these fan letters are 
practically like new family members."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Family, huh! Then we've gotta give it a 
name!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, that was just a figure of 
speech... Even so, changing the name is 
going too—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: His name is 'Letter-rou'!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: You were wearing it after all?!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Well then, Tannhauser-san, the stage is 
yours to announce the details.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I've reread it tons and 
tons of times, so my reading will be 
flawless!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, Matikanetannhauser. I always watch 
your races."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"...'I've always been mediocre at 
everything I tried, and gave up quickly on 
whatever I did. However, seeing you run 
sparked a change in me.'..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Facing any opponent, in any race, giving 
it your all and pouring out everything you 
have. Seeing you like that moved me 
deeply"—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Are you okay, Tannhauser?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Mmm-mm, it's okay, totally fine. Let's 
continue, then.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
—"Please continue to stay healthy and give 
it your all with boundless energy." Yes, 
yes! I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"‘Machikane Tannhauser is a special hero 
to me’...gah!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Waaaaah~~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You're crying in the end anyway?! Haven't 
you read this a bunch of times already?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
W-Well yeah, but... I just got a little 
emotional...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Knowing that I've become special to 
someone is just so touching, I can't 
even...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A-Anywayth! "I'm gonna keep... giving it 
my absolute super-duper best!" ...is what 
I think I'll write back!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And having received courage from her 
fans, Matikanetannhauser renewed her 
determination to do her best.
